pages: Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, leans over the road bridge rail and reads one black-and-white graduated staff gauge bolted to the concrete abutment, eyes level with the water. Middle distance: the steel rail, her field book. Background: slack grey-green channel, the gravel bar. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, stands mid-span on the road bridge looking at one phone held flat in both hands, its screen glowing. Middle distance: the steel handrail, the automatic gauge housing on the abutment. Background: the slack grey-green channel and gravel bar below. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, leans over one sheet of the rating curve on her desk, tracing the pencil line through a cloud of plotted points. Middle distance: a steel straightedge, an open field book. Background: the office window, a wall map. Soft window daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, holds one steel straightedge flat across the old rating sheet on her desk, sighting along the drawn line into the thin scatter of points near the top of the sheet. Middle distance: her field book, a pencil. Background: the office window. Grey daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, holds one phone above the desk and reads the incoming rain forecast, her thumb on the screen. Middle distance: the pinned rating curve sheet, a folded river road map. Background: the office window, a low grey sky. Flat daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, stands knee-deep on the gravel bar and pushes one graduated aluminium wading rod down until its steel shoe touches the bed. Middle distance: a propeller meter on a wand, a field book in a waterproof pouch. Background: shallow grey-green water, gravel. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, holds one banded ranging pole upright in the water and sights along it, cutting the river into measured pieces. Middle distance: the wading rod, the propeller meter. Background: the wide shallow channel, grey-green water. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, writes in one field book held flat against the wading rod while the current runs past her thighs. Middle distance: the propeller meter on its wand, the pole line across the river. Background: deep water, gravel bar. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, sits on the bridge guardrail unscrewing one dented aluminium flask, eyes on the water below. Middle distance: the wading rod propped at the rail, her field book. Background: the gravel bar, grey-green slack channel. Flat morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, walks the length of the dry gravel bar, holding one graduated wading rod out ahead of her to find the low point. Middle distance: the propeller meter on its wand, her field book. Background: slack grey-green channel either side. Mid-morning light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, holds one phone to her ear and reads two numbers off the open field book in front of her. Middle distance: the rating curve sheet, a pencil. Background: the office window, grey daylight on the wall behind.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, leans back through one old field notebook on her desk, fingertip resting on a single dated column of figures. Middle distance: the current field book, a steel ruler. Background: the office window, wet boots under the desk. Grey daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, lays one steel ruler along the drawn profile of the gravel bar on the desk sheet and works the error with a fingertip. Middle distance: a calculator, the field book. Background: the office window, her wet boots. Grey afternoon daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, stands on the road bridge in hard rain with one hand on the rail beside the staff gauge, watching the brown water rise. Middle distance: her field book, the wading rod. Background: the gravel bar, the river road embankment. Wet grey afternoon light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, sits at the desk with one rating curve sheet in front of her, one new point marked low on the line. Middle distance: a pencil, the open field book. Background: the office window, rain on the glass. Flat grey daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, works across one sheet of paper with a pencil, shading the wide band between the old line and her own. Middle distance: a steel ruler, a box of drawing pins. Background: the office wall, the window. Grey daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, stands at the bridge rail in the dark holding one torch down on the drowned river road, its beam skimming the brown water. Middle distance: the sodium lights of the hydro station, her field book. Background: the gravel bar under water, night.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, drives one graduated wading rod down into black flood water to her waist, steadying it with both hands. Middle distance: the propeller meter on its wand, her field book. Background: the sodium-lit hydro station across the water. Night, torch glow.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, pins one loop of pencil curves to the office wall and draws a soft line down its middle. Middle distance: a box of drawing pins, the field book. Background: the office window, the desk. Flat Friday daylight.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, writes in one log book open on the desk, a number entered in the box and two more crowded into the margin. Middle distance: a pen, the pinned loop on the wall. Background: the office window, grey light.

Mere Tipene, a woman of forty-four in chest waders and a deep-yellow storm jacket, closes one hardback field book on the desk and looks up through the window at the water. Middle distance: her pen, the rating curve sheet. Background: the gravel bar showing clear, the abutment board. Flat morning light.
